# Hooked 🎣

**The fishing trip booking marketplace for all of Argentina.** Anglers compare verified
fishing guides, lodges and experiences by province, species and trip type — and book
online with secure payments. No WhatsApp ping-pong, no sketchy phone numbers.

**Our mission:** make Argentina a world-class fishing destination. From the golden
dorado rivers of the litoral to Patagonia's trout waters — one platform, every
experience.

🌐 **[hooked.com.ar](https://hooked.com.ar?utm_source=github&utm_medium=backlink&utm_campaign=lanzamiento)**

---

## For anglers

- 🔍 Search verified guides, lodges and experiences **across all of Argentina** — by province, species and modality
- 🐟 Huge species variety: golden dorado, surubí, tararira, sea-run trout, patagonia trout & more
- ⭐ **Real reviews** from anglers who actually booked the trip
- 📅 Real-time availability and **online booking with secure payments** via Mercado Pago
- 💰 Clear pricing — no hidden fees, no haggling

## For fishing guides, lodges and outfitters

- 🧑‍ Boats, team, trip packages and lodge stays on a professional profile
- 📈 Your own booking page with a calendar that updates itself
- 💳 Get paid online — marketplace split payments via Mercado Pago
- 🇦🇷 Built in Argentina, by people who know the rivers

## Why Argentina

- 🥇 A world-class fishery waiting to be discovered — golden dorado on the fly, trophy surubí, Patagonian trout
- 🎓 Professional guides with deep local knowledge, vetted and reviewed
- 🏕️ Lodges and full experiences, not just day trips

## Where we operate

Nationwide — Argentina, top to bottom.
